title: Coastal Dream | KEY.co
description_expanded: Featuring seven spacious bedrooms, this property ensures ample space for relaxation and rejuvenation. The first floor welcomes you with a regal King Bedroom, complete with a separate shower and tub for ultimate comfort. A convenient half bath is also located on this floor. On the second floor, discover a majestic King Master Bedroom boasting a separate shower and tub, providing an oasis of tranquility. Accompanying this sanctuary are two more King Bedrooms, each with Twin/Twin Bunk beds, offering a delightful retreat for families or groups. A charming Twin/Twin Bunk room provides cozy accommodations for up to four guests, sharing a bathroom with a shower. The third floor features a serene Queen Bedroom and a marvelous King Bedroom, both sharing well-appointed bathrooms with refreshing showers, ensuring a seamless experience for all guests. Escape to a vacation home that perfectly blends the timeless allure of old Florida with cutting-edge amenities. Nestled just one block away from beach access, this remarkable property showcases breathtaking Gulf views from every porch. Prepare to be pampered in true luxury as you indulge in multiple living areas, a bonus room, a private pool, and an expansive outdoor entertaining space. This exquisite home offers an array of amenities that will transform your getaway into a heavenly retreat.
